decision.why: Data and baseline inspection show substantial melody errors and missing chords. Read the benchmark audit before choosing a small experiment, especially because chord timing is currently unscored.
decision.hypothesis: The format audit can distinguish recognition failures from conversion failures and identify a feasible intervention within the four-experiment budget.
decision.expected_observation: Documented format constraints, failure mechanisms and evaluation limitations that support a concrete pilot assignment.

sources.title: Supplied-score benchmark and format audit
sources.claim: 32 development excerpts, seven songs. Enlarged Audiveris recovers 47/200 structured chords; Transcoda omits the chord spine and sometimes repeats notes. Plain OCR words are not yet promoted to harmony. Some outputs fail parsing.
sources.application: Separate image/model failures from output-format and text-to-harmony integration. Compare fixed paired inputs.
sources.limit: References unaudited; chord timing and human correction time unmeasured. No agent comparison.
